title: Loyalty Unpacked – Walgreens
summary: The NALA™ examines how simplicity, personalization and broad reach support customer retention in Loyalty Unpacked Walgreens and its model.
body_markdown:
myWalgreens, the free program with more than 134 million members, covering one in three American consumers.


The design is deliberately light: no tiers, no points, and a phone number at checkout is the entire barrier to entry, with a flat 1% back as the whole base cost. Member-only sale prices do the persuading.


In 2026, that coverage has a new job. As Walgreens closes stores, the membership is the bridge: prescriptions transfer, the app redirects, offers re-personalize. The footprint shrinks without the customer base shrinking with it.


[DOWNLOAD FULL PDF HERE](https://the-nala.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Loyalty-Unpacked-Walgreens-1.pdf)


*Loyalty Unpacked ™️ is NALA’s independent content series exploring some of North America’s most recognised loyalty programs. Rather than reviewing features or scoring, we examine the commercial thinking behind programs, the problems they’re trying to solve and the questions they raise. Each edition offers practical observations, honest challenges and a NALA Insight ™️ designed to help loyalty, CRM and customer engagement teams think differently about the decisions shaping modern loyalty.*
